summary: Castor Maritime Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 11, 2026, in Limassol, Cyprus. Shareholders re-elected Petros Panagiotidis as Class C Director until the 2029 AGM and appointed Deloitte Certified Public Accountants S.A. as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No transaction, stake, price, or strategic event is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-results filing, the US-equivalent of an 8-K furnishing ordinary annual meeting outcomes, with no deal terms and no risk-arb angle.
